status.en: 2 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Bangui, Bambouti and Gardai.
status.nb: 2 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Bangui, Bambouti og Gardai.

summary.en: Armed clashes continue in Bangui among government forces, former Séléka rebels, Anti-balaka militias, Russian Wagner troops and Africa Corps, while France and Chad have resumed military cooperation, including planned air force training and a fighter jet visit. Chad is hosting hundreds of thousands of Sudanese refugees, extending the regional humanitarian crisis, and children of Darfur refugees are growing up in the same camps. Switzerland has frozen MSF funding after reports of sexual exploitation in Chad. UNICEF emphasizes water as a basic right. The conflict recorded 246 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
